scope: Official public documentation research only; no live wallet eligibility established and no claim attempted.
review_policy: No adapter activation without a current individual campaign ID, official participant claim API permission, zero mandatory fees and gas, Solana mainnet compatibility, live eligibility and explicit operator authorization.

candidates.name: Galxe Quest / Earndrop
candidates.notes: REST credential is for Space Owners to verify tasks, not general permission to automate participant claims. Official notice: no new campaigns after 2026-11-09; participation until 2026-12-05; rewards claim until 2026-12-15.

candidates.name: thirdweb Distribute Tokens
candidates.notes: Gas sponsored, but requires deployed token contract, funded issuer server wallet and issuer secret. Example POST /api/claim belongs to an application created by issuer, not a general participant API.

candidates.name: Solana JSON-RPC requestAirdrop
candidates.notes: Documented and programmable faucet for testing only. Test SOL is not mainnet SOL and cannot be counted as earnings.

candidates.name: TON Console Jetton Airdrop
candidates.notes: Recipient connects through TON Connect and signs claim, pays fixed claim fee plus blockchain fee; not supported by Solana wallet and not zero cost.

candidates.name: Helium Hotspot Rewards
candidates.notes: Oracle REST API provides lifetime rewards, but reward claim requires signed Solana transaction and fees; hotspot ownership not a free individual airdrop.

candidates.name: LayerHop Airdrop Claim Checker
candidates.notes: The public GET /v1/claims reads third-party eligibility; documentation directs users to official campaign sites for claims and does not build transactions. Not an official individual campaign API.

candidates.name: Solana Actions and Blinks
candidates.notes: Action API prepares a transaction for user preview, signature and submission; this is not proof of a zero-cost unsigned participant claim.

candidates.name: Streamflow Airdrop Distribution
candidates.notes: Official distributor SDK offers claim functionality for recipients, but the 2026 fee schedule lists airdrop claim fees of 0.0237 to 0.0317 SOL. Wallet approval/signature is also required; no verified zero-capital claim route for this participant.

candidates.name: Solana Kora Fee Sponsorship
candidates.notes: Solana paymaster infrastructure can sponsor fees when a specific application provides and funds a relayer, but it does not create entitlement, campaign allocation, an official participant claim endpoint, or permission to automate claiming.

candidates.name: Solana Rewards Program Merkle Distribution
candidates.notes: This is a reusable onchain direct/Merkle distribution protocol. Claim methods are transactions against campaign-specific recipient allocation, not a public free-reward faucet or general unsigned HTTP claim service. No qualifying campaign entitlement was established.
